property_summary: For every input where the external calls succeed, the transfer function must return true; the buggy version returns false instead.
The return value of the transfer function must be true whenever all sub-calls succeed and false whenever any sub-call reverts; the buggy version always returns false, violating this rule.
For any successful call to `transfer`, the return value must be `true`; the buggy version returns `false` for all successful calls, violating this rule.
For any inputs where all internal calls succeed, the transfer function must return true; the buggy version instead returns false.
For any input where the transfer call does not revert, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false without reverting, violating this rule.
